input.title: Unisex Ferret – Borrowed Your Sock. Forever. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

BORROWED YOUR SOCK. FOREVER. is the ferret hoodie for the owner whose socks keep disappearing into a secret stash, worn at home, at the pet store and as a gift for the friend who has never found the other one.

BORROWED YOUR SOCK. stacks over two lines across the top and FOREVER. fills the bottom in huge slab capitals. Between them a ferret pops half out of a heap of mismatched striped, dotted and plain socks with one striped sock in its mouth and bright pleased eyes, a small key and a hair tie peeking out of the pile.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the sock pile; Sand gets deep brown and rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this ferret hoodie warm enough for chilly mornings and weekends at home?
Yes. The Borrowed Your Sock. Forever. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for chilly mornings, weekends at home and trips to the pet store.

How does the Borrowed Your Sock. Forever. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a ferret owner?
It is a natural one. Every ferret owner has searched for a missing sock and found the stash, so it lands with ferret people, shelter volunteers and the friends who have lost a few pairs. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the sock pile sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Borrowed Your Sock. Forever. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
